name: Clifton
card: An unincorporated community east of Grand Junction with its own searches.
near: It sits east of Grand Junction, before Palisade.
metaTitle: Clifton Websites and Local SEO | Nick Perry Digital
metaDescription: Local SEO and websites for Clifton, Colorado businesses. Clifton is not a separate city, and the listing should not pretend otherwise.
body:
Clifton is a census-designated place in Mesa County, not its own city. People still search for services there, and a business on the east side of the valley should not hide behind a generic Grand Junction page if Clifton is where the customers are.

The Google listing has to use a real address category. If you are a service-area business, we set the areas you drive. We do not invent a storefront.
businesses: Home services based on the east side of the valley
Offices that draw from Clifton and Palisade
extraQ: Clifton is not a city. Does a page still help?
extraA: Yes, if customers use the name. The page should say you serve Clifton and name the real base of the business. It should not pretend Clifton is a city you have an office in when you do not.
